requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 使用 TM1637 + DHT11（D7）：显示温度，每 2 秒刷新
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: Provide a sequence of DHT temperature readings on io_0 with validity io_2 true at least once every 2 seconds; interleave steps with io_2 false while holding io_0 to new (possibly different) values.
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: Whenever io_2 is true, io_3 updates to the integer floor of the new io_0 temperature (clamped to [0, 2147483647]); whenever io_2 is false, io_3 retains the last displayed valid temperature (same floor/clamp) despite io_0 changing.
